## Original observations

```{r}
#| label: read-og-obs
# original observations
og_obs <- readRDS(here(
  L301_data_dir,
  "301b_ETF_EPT_IDS_api_uploads.rds"
)) |>
  # Read in iNat metadata
  left_join(
    read_rds(here(
      L1_data_dir,
      "101a_images_clean_ETF_EPT_obs.rds"
    )),
    join_by(observation_id == id)
  ) |>
  filter(batch_id == 0) # Test batch uploaded to iNat via API
```

```{r}
#| label: parse-og-obs
og_obs_base <- og_obs |>
  select(
    ## observation info
    observation_id,
    quality_grade,
    ### community taxon
    taxon_name = taxon.name,
    taxon_id = taxon.id,
    taxon_ancestry = taxon.min_species_ancestry,
    taxon_species_id = taxon.min_species_taxon_id,
    taxon_rank_level = taxon.rank_level,
    taxon_rank = taxon.rank,
    ### observer info
    observer_id = user.id,
    observer_login = user.login,
    observer_obs_cnt = user.observations_count,
    observer_ids_cnt = user.identifications_count,
    observer_spp_cnt = user.species_count,
    ### summary info (ids, com)
    identifications_count,
    num_identification_agreements,
    num_identification_disagreements,
    identification_disagreements_count,
    identifications_some_agree,
    comments_count,
    ### dataframes of ids, ann, com
    identifications,
    comments,
    annotations
  )
```

### Original subtables of identifications, annotations, comments

```{r}
#| label: og-obs-ids-table
og_obs_ids <- og_obs_base |>
  select(observation_id, identifications) |>
  unnest_longer(identifications) |>
  unpack(identifications, names_sep = "_") |>
  select(
    observation_id,
    identification_id = identifications_id,
    identifier_comment = identifications_body,
    identification_vision = identifications_vision,
    identification_own = identifications_own_observation,
    identifier_id = identifications_user.id,
    identifier_login = identifications_user.login,
    identification_taxon_id = identifications_taxon_id,
    identification_current = identifications_current,
    identification_created_at = identifications_created_at
  ) |>
  mutate(
    identification_occurrence = case_when(
      as.Date(identification_created_at) <= as.Date("2026-07-23") ~ "before",
      TRUE ~ "after"
    )
  )
```

## Updated observations

```{r}
#| label: read-upd-obs
# updated observations
upd_obs <- readRDS(here(L3_data_dir, "302_updated_obs.rds")) |>
  rename(observation_id = id)
```

```{r}
#| label: FX-parse-json
safe_parse <- function(x) {
  map(
    x,
    ~ if (is.na(.x) || .x == "" || is.null(.x)) {
      list()
    } else {
      fromJSON(.x, simplifyDataFrame = TRUE)
    }
  )
}
```

```{r}
#| label: parse-upd-obs
parsed_upd_obs <- upd_obs |>
  mutate(
    taxon = if (is.character(taxon)) safe_parse(taxon) else taxon,
    user = if (is.character(user)) safe_parse(user) else user,
    identifications = if (is.character(identifications)) {
      safe_parse(identifications)
    } else {
      identifications
    },
    comments = if (is.character(comments)) safe_parse(comments) else comments,
    annotations = if (is.character(annotations)) {
      safe_parse(annotations)
    } else {
      annotations
    }
  )


upd_obs_base <- parsed_upd_obs |>
  # taxon information
  hoist(
    taxon,
    taxon_name = "name",
    taxon_id = "id",
    taxon_ancestry = "min_species_ancestry",
    taxon_species_id = "min_species_taxon_id",
    taxon_rank_level = "rank_level",
    taxon_rank = "rank"
  ) |>
  # observer information
  hoist(
    user,
    observer_id = "id",
    observer_login = "login",
    observer_obs_cnt = "observations_count",
    observer_ids_cnt = "identifications_count",
    observer_spp_cnt = "species_count"
  ) |>
  select(
    ## observation info
    observation_id,
    quality_grade,
    ### community taxon
    starts_with("taxon_"),
    ### observer info
    starts_with("observer_"),
    ### summary info (ids, com)
    identifications_count,
    num_identification_agreements,
    num_identification_disagreements,
    identification_disagreements_count,
    identifications_some_agree,
    comments_count,
    ### dataframes of ids, ann, com
    identifications,
    comments,
    annotations
  )
```


### Updated subtables of identifications, annotations, comments

```{r}
#| label: FX-extract-user-fields
pull_user_field <- function(user_col, field = "id") {
  if (is.null(user_col)) {
    return(character(0))
  }
  if (is.data.frame(user_col)) {
    as.character(user_col[[field]] %||% NA_character_)
  } else if (is.list(user_col)) {
    map_chr(user_col, ~ as.character(.x[[field]] %||% NA_character_))
  } else {
    as.character(user_col)
  }
}
```

```{r}
#| label: FX-flatten-body-text
pull_clean_body <- function(body_col, n_rows) {
  if (is.null(body_col) || is.data.frame(body_col)) {
    rep(NA_character_, n_rows)
  } else if (is.list(body_col)) {
    map_chr(
      body_col,
      ~ if (length(.x) == 0 || is.null(.x)) {
        NA_character_
      } else {
        as.character(.x[[1]])
      }
    )
  } else {
    as.character(body_col)
  }
}
```

```{r}
#| label: FX-guard-empty-elements
is_empty_entry <- function(x) {
  is.null(x) || length(x) == 0 || (is.data.frame(x) && nrow(x) == 0)
}
```

```{r}
#| label: upd-obs-ids-table
upd_obs_ids <- upd_obs_base |>
  select(observation_id, identifications) |>
  mutate(
    identifications = map(identifications, function(df) {
      if (is_empty_entry(df)) {
        return(tibble())
      }

      # Force to df if not already
      df <- as_tibble(df)

      # Assemble desired columns
      tibble(
        identification_id = as.integer(df[["id"]]),
        identifier_comment = pull_clean_body(df[["body"]], nrow(df)),
        identification_vision = as.logical(df[["vision"]] %||% NA),
        identification_own = as.logical(df[["own_observation"]] %||% NA),
        identifier_id = as.integer(pull_user_field(df[["user"]], "id")),
        identifier_login = pull_user_field(df[["user"]], "login"),
        identification_taxon_id = as.integer(df[["taxon_id"]] %||% NA),
        identification_current = as.logical(df[["current"]] %||% NA),
        identification_created_at = as.character(df[["created_at"]] %||% NA)
      )
    })
  ) |>
  unnest(identifications) |>
  mutate(
    identification_occurrence = case_when(
      as.Date(identification_created_at) <= as.Date("2026-07-23") ~ "before",
      TRUE ~ "after"
    )
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: upd-obs-ann-table
upd_obs_ann <- upd_obs_base |>
  select(observation_id, annotations) |>
  mutate(
    annotations = map(annotations, function(df) {
      if (is_empty_entry(df)) {
        return(tibble())
      }

      # Force to df if not already
      df <- as_tibble(df)

      # Assemble desired columns
      tibble(
        annotation_uuid = as.character(df[["uuid"]] %||% NA),
        annotation_attr_id = as.integer(
          df[["controlled_attribute_id"]] %||% NA
        ),
        annotation_value_id = as.integer(df[["controlled_value_id"]] %||% NA),
        annotator_id = as.integer(pull_user_field(df[["user"]], "id")),
        annotator_login = pull_user_field(df[["user"]], "login")
      )
    })
  ) |>
  unnest(annotations)
```


```{r}
#| label: upd-obs-com-table
upd_obs_com <- upd_obs_base |>
  select(observation_id, comments) |>
  mutate(
    comments = map(comments, function(df) {
      if (is_empty_entry(df)) {
        return(tibble())
      }

      # Force to df if not already
      df <- as_tibble(df)

      # Assemble desired columns
      tibble(
        comment_id = as.integer(df[["id"]]),
        commenter_id = as.integer(pull_user_field(df[["user"]], "id")),
        comment_created_at = as.character(df[["created_at"]] %||% NA),
        comment_body = pull_clean_body(df[["body"]], nrow(df))
      )
    })
  ) |>
  unnest(comments) |>
  mutate(
    comment_occurrence = case_when(
      as.Date(comment_created_at) <= as.Date("2026-07-23") ~ "before",
      TRUE ~ "after"
    )
  )
```


# Explore data

## Identifications

```{r}
#| label: id-comments-added
# Get number of ID comments where I added no comment, or I added
# "Supporting order-level identification, not necessarily disagreeing with finer resolutions"
upd_obs_ids |>
  filter(identifier_login == "kmtorres") |>
  filter(str_detect(identifier_comment, "Supporting Order-level ID")) |>
  count(identification_occurrence) # 6,008 with comment

upd_obs_ids |>
  filter(identifier_login == "kmtorres") |>
  filter(is.na(identifier_comment)) |>
  count(identification_occurrence) # 3,890 without comment
```

```{r}
#| label: ids-added
# Between Feb and Sep (added IDs in Late July),
# there were 264 IDs added to 9900 observations, excluding the 9,898 added
# by kmtorres (2 obs were removed from platform)

# IDs added: 10,162
IDs_added <- upd_obs_ids |>
  filter(identification_occurrence == "after") |>
  count()

# IDs added by kmtorres: 9,898
my_IDs <- upd_obs_ids |>
  filter(
    identifier_login == "kmtorres" & identification_occurrence == "after"
  ) |>
  count()

# IDs added not by kmtorres: 264
IDs_added - my_IDs
```

```{r}
#| label: prep-id-change
# observations after adding IDs in July
after_obs <- upd_obs_base |>
  select(
    observation_id,
    taxon_id,
    taxon_rank,
    taxon_rank_level,
    identifications_count
  ) |>
  mutate(
    observation_id = as.integer(observation_id),
    identifications_count = as.integer(identifications_count)
  )

# observations before adding IDs in July
before_obs <- og_obs_base |>
  select(
    observation_id,
    taxon_id,
    taxon_rank,
    taxon_rank_level,
    identifications_count
  ) |>
  mutate(observation_id = as.integer(observation_id))

# Join observation data
both_obs <- full_join(
  before_obs,
  after_obs,
  by = "observation_id",
  suffix = c("_before", "_after")
) |>
  mutate(
    changed_obs = case_when(
      identifications_count_before != identifications_count_after ~ "Changed",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

change_in_obs <- both_obs |>
  filter(changed_obs == "Changed") |>
  mutate(
    # Smaller level number = finer taxonomic rank
    direction = case_when(
      taxon_rank_level_after < taxon_rank_level_before ~ "Finer",
      taxon_rank_level_after > taxon_rank_level_before ~ "Coarser",
      taxon_rank_level_after == taxon_rank_level_before ~ "Unchanged",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    # Build labels of taxon direction chaneg
    change_type = case_when(
      direction == "Unchanged" ~ paste0(
        "Unchanged - ",
        str_to_sentence(taxon_rank_before)
      ),
      !is.na(direction) ~ paste0(
        direction,
        " - ",
        str_to_sentence(taxon_rank_before),
        " to ",
        str_to_sentence(taxon_rank_after)
      ),
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )
```


```{r}
#| label: save-id-change-df
write_rds(change_in_obs, here(L3_data_dir, "303_EPT_ID_change.rds"))
```

```{r}
#| label: Fig4-viz-ids
## Fig 4a Visualize directionality change in community taxon identifiation consensus
dir_summary <- change_in_obs |>
  count(direction) |>
  mutate(
    pct = n / sum(n) * 100,
    label = paste0(scales::comma(n), " (", round(pct, 1), "%)"),
    direction = factor(direction, levels = c("Unchanged", "Finer", "Coarser"))
  )

fig4a_direction <- ggplot(
  dir_summary,
  aes(x = pct, y = fct_rev(direction), fill = direction)
) +
  geom_col(width = 0.55, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_text(aes(label = label), vjust = -1, size = 5) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Unchanged" = "#2b83ba",
      "Finer" = "#2ca25f",
      "Coarser" = "#d7191c"
    )
  ) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 110), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(
    title = "A. Community Taxon Identification Consensus (n = 2,956)",
    x = "% of Changed Observations",
    y = "Consensus Direction"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 16) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))
fig4a_direction

## Fig 4b Visualize taxonomic change in shifts of the community taxon id
shift_summary <- change_in_obs |>
  filter(direction != "Unchanged") |>
  count(change_type, direction) |>
  filter(n >= 5) |> # drop isolated 1-2 counts of changed obs
  mutate(
    change_type = fct_reorder(change_type, n)
  )

fig4b_shift <- ggplot(
  shift_summary,
  aes(x = n, y = change_type, fill = direction)
) +
  geom_col(width = 0.65, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0("n = ", n)), hjust = -0.15, size = 5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Finer" = "#2ca25f", "Coarser" = "#d7191c")) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(0, max(shift_summary$n) * 1.3),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "B. Taxonomic Shifts in Consensus (n ≥ 5)",
    x = "Number of Observations",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 16) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))
fig4b_shift
```


```{r}
#| label: Fig4-export-fig
# Combine Fig4a and Fig 4b
figure4 <- fig4a_direction +
  fig4b_shift +
  plot_layout(widths = c(1, 1.2))
figure4

# Save Fig 4
ggsave(
  filename = here(
    L3_data_dir,
    "303_figure4_change_in_ids.png"
  ),
  plot = figure4,
  width = 16,
  height = 10,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white"
)
```
